title: 第1章 我需要一个助力
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

梵帝神界

“帝上，你可考虑清楚了，带着妾身一起进入深渊？”

千叶影儿那一双金眸盯着云澈，眼神之中略显不解。

在数日前，云澈就说过自己要独自一人跳下深渊。

如今，距离他跳下深渊只剩下了一天时间，来到梵帝神界说这件事。

云澈道：“这件事情并非临时起意。”

“魔血。”

千叶影儿想到了什么，从口中说出魔血。

拥有魔血的她能够与云澈进行双修，在极短时间内提升云澈实力。

“并非。”

云澈摇头，缓缓而语道：

“在深渊，我需要一个助力，而这个助力就是你。”

深渊的未知，他不知道自己是否可以颠覆深渊。

他这几日都在思考这件事情，也与池妩仸交谈了。

交谈之后，就一致的认为需要一个助力。

千叶影儿听到这句话，她的黛眉狠狠一蹙：

“池妩仸体内拥有涅轮魔魂，是你最好的助力。”

池妩仸体内的涅轮魔魂是最后的魔帝之魂。

要说谁是云澈下深渊后的最佳助理，那定然就是池妩仸了。

云澈：“妩仸她将八分魔魂给了我。”

八分魔魂，云澈本想拒绝这件事情，可池妩仸根本不给他拒绝的机会，直接给了。

“什么！？”

千叶影儿声音在云澈这句话后，变得有些慌乱起来：

“八分魔魂给了你，那池妩仸仅剩下两分魔魂。”

池妩仸的举动在千叶影儿这里无疑是最为莽撞的举动。

过了一会，千叶影儿也就释然了。

池妩仸对云澈太好了，任何事情都纵容着云澈。

深渊，未知之地，神界的一切的寄托在了云澈之手。

池妩仸将八分魔魂给云澈就是为了防止云澈在深渊之中发生一些意外后，可以解决这件事情。

云澈双目与千叶影儿的金眸对视：

“至于下深渊这件事情，你是否跟随我前往，这是你自己的决定。”

他一指轻轻的点在了千叶影儿的眉心之上。

一副画面在千叶影儿的脑海之内浮现而出。

Page (1/3)

Brahma Emperor God Realm

"My Lord, have you thought carefully about taking this concubine into the abyss with you?"

Qianye Ying'er's golden eyes stared at Yun Che with a hint of confusion in her eyes.

A few days ago, Yun Che said that he would jump into the abyss alone.

Now, there was only one day left before he jumped into the abyss and came to the Brahma Emperor God Realm to talk about it.

Yun Che said: "This matter is not a temporary matter."

"Demon blood."

Qianye Ying'er thought of something and spoke the demon blood from her mouth.

With demon blood, she can perform dual cultivation with Yun Che, improving Yun Che's strength in a very short period of time.

"No."

Yun Che shook his head and said slowly:

"In the abyss, I need a helper, and that helper is you."

The unknown of the abyss, he didn't know if he could subvert the abyss.

He has been thinking about this matter for the past few days and also talked with Chi Wuyao.

After the conversation, we all agreed that we needed help.

When Qianye Ying'er heard this, her eyebrows frowned:

"Chi Wuyao has the Nirvana Demon Soul in her body, which is your best help."

The Nirvana Demon Soul in Chi Wuyao's body is the last Demon Emperor's soul.

If anyone wants to say who is Yun Che's best assistant after he goes into the abyss, it must be Chi Wuyao.

Yun Che: "Wuyao gave me eight points of her demon soul."

Eight-point demon soul, Yun Che wanted to refuse this matter, but Chi Wuyao gave it to him without giving him a chance to refuse.

"What!?"

Qianye Ying'er's voice became a little flustered after Yun Che's words:

"I gave you eight points of the demon soul, and Chi Wuyao only has two points of the demon soul left."

Chi Wuyao's move was undoubtedly the most reckless move for Qianye Ying'er.

After a while, Qianye Ying'er felt relieved.

Chi Wuyao was too kind to Yun Che and indulged Yun Che in everything.

The abyss, the unknown land, everything in the divine world rests on Yun Che's hands.

Chi Wuyao gave eight points of the demon soul to Yun Che just to prevent Yun Che from solving the matter after some accident happened in the abyss.

Yun Che's eyes met Qianye Ying'er's golden eyes:

"As for going down to the abyss, whether you follow me there or not is your own decision."

He gently tapped Qianye Ying'er's eyebrows with one finger.

A picture emerged in Qianye Ying'er's mind.
